global: This miso ramen features a rich, dark broth with visible chashu pork and a perfectly halved soft-boiled egg. The bowl, adorned with red geometric patterns, sits on a vibrant red surface under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Red table surface has smooth texture and slight sheen, with visible circular tray edge beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and Chinese characters along its rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, rich brown with oily sheen, swirls around noodles, green onions, and soft-boiled egg halves.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk with a slightly runny center, surrounded by firm white, both halves resting on a gray surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, browned slices with visible fat marbling and seared surface texture.
